The stylus has a slightly 'melted' or overly smooth appearance where the tip meets the body, lacking sharp mechanical definition. The shadow under the stylus is also somewhat diffuse and disconnected.
The transition between the silver casing and the black screen bezel is slightly soft and indistinct, lacking the crisp hard-surface modeling expected of manufactured plastic.
